# ex: binary expression replacement doesn't need selector paren context
ex {
	var x int
	F(x) -> x * 2
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F(x int) int { return x * 2 }

func G() int {
	return F(3)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -3,5 +3,5 @@
 func F(x int) int { return x * 2 }

 func G() int {
-	return F(3)
+	return 3 * 2
 }
